title: Communion letters held in the Archives of the Impossible

tellings.quote: four or 5 thousand of them are now at Rice University in a in an archive called the Archives of the Impossible, founded by Jeff Kriel.

plain: Thousands of letters that readers wrote to the writer Whitley Strieber after his book Communion, about his own reported encounters with strange beings, are now said to be kept at Rice University in Houston. Strieber tells Michels that "four or 5 thousand of them" sit in an archive there called the Archives of the Impossible, which he says was founded by Jeff Kripal. If so, a large body of people's accounts of similar experiences has been preserved for study.
